preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 100 for x in [int(stdin.split()[0]), int(stdin.split()[1])])
preconditions.description: Input consists of two integers a and b, where 0 ≤ a, b ≤ 100, representing the count of even and odd steps, respectively.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'YES') == (any((a + b) % 2 == 0 and a >= 0 and b >= 0 and (a + b) >= 1 for a in [int(stdin.split()[0])] for b in [int(stdin.split()[1])]))
postconditions.description: Output is 'YES' if and only if there exists an interval [l, r] (1 ≤ l ≤ r) where the number of even steps equals a and the number of odd steps equals b. This is possible if and only if the total number of steps (a + b) is non-zero, and the parity of the interval length (a + b) matches the parity of the starting step (l). Since the parity of l can be chosen freely (odd or even), the only constraint is that (a + b) must be non-zero and the parity of (a + b) must be consistent with the parity of the starting step (which is always possible to choose).
